d153.reading_scope: complete extracted text, PDF pages 1-51; no independent figure inspection

hansen2001.assessment: Established pulsed quadrature and coherent-state tomography; not a Dirac stress measurement

marecki2007.assessment: Detector output is a filtered electric correlation; background-dependent commutator and Casimir spectrum

marecki-qft2007.reading_scope: PDF pages 1-3 and 12-15; related derivation fully read in 0711.1541
marecki-qft2007.assessment: Smooth switching, nonmonochromatic LO and external-background detector limitations; not a universal energy-density inverse

marecki2002.reading_scope: PDF pages 2-6 and 12-17: observable definition, selected positivity derivation and Appendix A, remarks and optical interpretation
marecki2002.assessment: Electric-square inequality differs from total electromagnetic stress; magnetic field and frequency limitations explicit; extraction has spaced glyphs

fewster-mistry2003.reading_scope: PDF pages 1-9: definitions, operator positivity proof through Eq2.29, massless Eq3.2, conclusion and Fourier lemma
fewster-mistry2003.assessment: Free four-dimensional Minkowski Dirac timelike QWEI; cannot import unchanged into the current curved charged boundary problem

fewster-verch2001.reading_scope: abstract; PDF page16 Theorem4.1 and reference-state definition; page21 proof closure
fewster-verch2001.assessment: General reference-Hadamard difference QWEI; complete microlocal proof not independently reverified

maclay-davis2018.reading_scope: primary HTML sections I-II and V-VII; PDF pages12-14 and16
maclay-davis2018.assessment: Alleged QI conflict relies on phase/time identification; no matched violation accepted

riek2016.reading_scope: PDF pages1-5: experiment, observable, detector contribution and interpretation
riek2016.assessment: Later subcycle electromagnetic fluctuation measurement; not a Dirac/gravity measurement

benea-chelmus2018.assessment: Later vacuum spatial/temporal correlation experiment, explicitly frequency-filtered; not total stress
